en: Black‑and‑white view over a river spanned by a multi‑span steel truss bridge carrying pedestrians, horse‑drawn carts and early vehicles into a dense European town. The banks are lined with boats and masonry buildings of 3–5 stories, many with steep tiled roofs, dormers, and ornate late‑19th‑century façades. In the distance are church spires and chimneys, with wooded hills behind the town. The image has the composition and tone of an early 20th‑century city postcard.
